title: Remove Account active targets sign out

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Removing an active account must require destructive confirmation before local or remote sign-out and before deleting the saved snapshot.
When the removed account is active on This Mac, CodexPill must sign out local auth and relaunch Codex before deleting the saved snapshot.
When the removed account is active on a connected remote host, CodexPill must sign out that host before deleting the saved snapshot and must stop presenting the removed account as remotely active.

targetSurface: CodexPill remove-account fake local and remote workflow boundary

nonClaims: Does not prove native confirmation panel rendering or click automation.
Does not exercise live Codex relaunch, live SSH sign-out, or real remote auth mutation.
Does not prove required sign-out failure handling.
